mini_task_spec:
Using the NestJS monorepo at `test-repo/`, identify the complete list of per-package TypeScript configuration files that a build agent would want to pre-warm into the `cache` brick before performing any analysis work. Specifically: find all files named exactly `tsconfig.json` (not `tsconfig.build.json`, not `tsconfig.spec.json`, not files inside `test/` subdirectories) that live directly in a named package subdirectory under `test-repo/packages/<package-name>/tsconfig.json` (i.e., at depth 2 below `packages/`, excluding the `packages/tsconfig.json` file that lives at depth 1). Report the paths relative to `test-repo/`, one per line, sorted alphabetically. This list is the input you would pass to the cache brick's `warmup` tool to pre-load these frequently-read config files.
